_about: The baptistery. 2026-10-08 (Josh): the modern water from SPAROOM applied here too -- the bath's water (ZQcutter01/02 at y -38 over zxwater at y -57, x 44..81, z 81..216) rippled, shiny and lit from below, with caustics on the bath and the wall beside it. Same look as SPAROOM's final settings, scaled to a bath: one lamp under its middle, a finer web, less height, and about half the light on the walls (the green moss turned the full strength neon).
